Bold Hearts. Brilliant Minds.

At UC Riverside you won’t just take classes—you’ll take action. Powered by a great education, world-leading research, and knowledge-driven impact, our students are transforming the nation and the world. Because at UCR, we are a tapestry of trailblazers—from first generation students to globally recognized researchers—bringing together fluency of thinking that accelerates bold solutions and transforms lives.

NEWS

October 21, 2026
UCR completing reaccreditation process
UC Riverside is completing the final steps of its reaccreditation with a campus visit from October 28-30 by the Western Association of Schools and Colleges, or WASC. The visit from the WASC Senior College and University Commission team follows a two-year process that began in 2024. UCR has been accredited since 1956 and typically must be reaccredited every six to 10 years. It was most recently reaccredited in 2018.
Read More »
September 22, 2026
UC Riverside is again No. 1 in the U.S. for social mobility
U.S. News & World Report has again named UC Riverside the No. 1 university in the nation for social mobility. UCR tied for the top social mobility ranking with Florida International University. This is the eighth year that U.S. News has featured a breakout category for social mobility. UCR has been ranked No. 1 for six of those eight years; it was No. 2 the other two years.
Read More »

More News

Bold Hearts. Brilliant Minds.

At UC Riverside you won’t just take classes—you’ll take action. Powered by a great education, world-leading research, and knowledge-driven impact, our students are transforming the nation and the world. Because at UCR, we are a tapestry of trailblazers—from first generation students to globally recognized researchers—bringing together fluency of thinking that accelerates bold solutions and transforms lives.

NEWS

October 21, 2026
UCR completing reaccreditation process
UC Riverside is completing the final steps of its reaccreditation with a campus visit from October 28-30 by the Western Association of Schools and Colleges, or WASC. The visit from the WASC Senior College and University Commission team follows a two-year process that began in 2024. UCR has been accredited since 1956 and typically must be reaccredited every six to 10 years. It was most recently reaccredited in 2018.
Read More »
September 22, 2026
UC Riverside is again No. 1 in the U.S. for social mobility
U.S. News & World Report has again named UC Riverside the No. 1 university in the nation for social mobility. UCR tied for the top social mobility ranking with Florida International University. This is the eighth year that U.S. News has featured a breakout category for social mobility. UCR has been ranked No. 1 for six of those eight years; it was No. 2 the other two years.
Read More »
